description: [forged] Offline validator for a Canadian Business Number (BN9) and its extended BN15 form (BN9 + 2-letter program identifier + 4-digit reference number, e.g. 123456782RT0001). Verifies the 9-digit BN via the Luhn checksum algorithm and, if present, decodes the program identifier (RC=Corporate income tax, RT=GST/HST, RP=Payroll, RM=Import/Export, RR=Registered charity, and others) into a human-readable program type. (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

value.description: BN9 (9 digits) or BN15 (9 digits + 2-letter program id + 4-digit reference), e.g. 123456782RT0001

name: bn_ca_validate
